entities.summary: Chatchai-decha Butdee, formerly Chatchai Butdee, is a Thai southpaw boxer who won a bronze medal at the 2013 World Championships. At the 2012 Summer Olympics, competing in the flyweight, he was defeated in his second bout. At the 2016 Summer Olympics, Butdee was again eliminated in his second bout. In Muay Thai he was known as Thapraya KimichiangKorsang (Thai: ตาพระยา กิมเชียงก่อสร้าง
